description: Selected physical body-heading correction plus independent pair guard; Estimator source and header are frozen round-1 baseline. Navigation/RouteMap are a fixed snapshot preceding all comparisons.
parameter_origin: 9.873 m master antenna to front bogie minus half of 7.55 m bogie spacing; selected from rigid vehicle geometry and train analysis before validation or public reference.
comparison: All 33 train + 13 validation representatives; same four GNSS schedules and exact common absolute-position masks. Two off-map train bags remain missing absolute coverage in both versions.
caution: This isolates navigation changes from subsequent Estimator recovery changes. Public reference is diagnostic only. Proxy improvements are not official hidden-test results.

diagnostic_followup.stationary_082f: 23 s stationary clip; paired startup body heading differs from map body heading by -13.97 degrees. Existing Navigation applies this correction to output yaw but not the antenna-to-base lever arm. Its 2.40 m error is consistent with a 9.873 m lever arm rotated by about 14 degrees. Parent is investigating a synthetic regression and consistent lever-arm correction.
diagnostic_followup.blackout_regressions: The three main regressions (dd8e6395, a53d5f6f, dd8d0741) lose a fortuitous positive rover-matching anchor bias: new rover observations agree more closely with independent master anchors and reduce lateral residuals from 2.5–2.9 m to 0.27–0.62 m, but change the anchor carried through the long GNSS blackout by about -0.7 to -0.9 m. The old bias partly compensated subsequent wheel/map errors.
diagnostic_followup.scope: These are diagnostics after physical-geometry selection; no parameter tuned on the validation trips. Saved geometry evidence predates any follow-up startup lever-arm fix or tentative-wheel freeze guard change.
